channel.title: Coastal Eventures: upcoming events
channel.description: The next 40 dated events on the Gulf Coast.

item.title: 14th Annual Bourbon at the Bay (THU 11/19)
item.description: Thursday 11/19 · time not yet posted | HarborWalk Village | No published price. The local chamber hosts the 14th annual Bourbon at the Bay on Thursday, November 19 at HarborWalk Village in Destin. The adults-only evening features premium bourbon tastings, high-end wine and champagne, heavy appetizers and a silent auction.

item.title: Adventure Zone at Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm (THU 11/19)
item.description: Mon-Sat through Dec 12 · weekdays 12 PM to 5 PM and Saturdays 9 AM to 5 PM from Nov 20 | Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm | from $19.45. Steve's Farm has rebranded as Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm and opened a fall attraction in Walnut Hill with a corn maze, a giant slide, a kids' zipline, a jump pad, hayrides, a wagon train, a sunflower field and a pumpkin patch. It suits a family with small children who want a half day outdoors. The farm's ticket page lists day passes at $15.00 to $19.45 and a $35 season pass, so check it for each day's hours before driving out.

item.title: Corrosion of Conformity & The Sword (THU 11/19)
item.description: Thu 11/19 · 7:00 PM (doors 6:00 PM) | Vinyl Music Hall | from $43. Corrosion of Conformity and The Sword share a metal bill at Vinyl Music Hall with support from Hippie Death Cult. Doors open at 6 PM for a 7 PM start, and the show is all ages.

item.title: Feelin' Crafty: Starfish Ornaments at Mustin Beach Club (THU 11/19)
item.description: Thursday 11/19 · time not published | Mustin Beach Club, NAS Pensacola | No published price. Navy MWR hosts a Feelin' Crafty class at Mustin Beach Club where guests make two starfish Christmas ornaments. The events page describes a relaxed, creative setting with new design skills taught along the way.

item.title: Finding Neverland at Joe Jefferson Playhouse (THU 11/19)
item.description: Fridays and Saturdays 7:30 PM · Sundays 2:30 PM | Joe Jefferson Playhouse | from $26.75. Joe Jefferson Players stage Finding Neverland, the musical about playwright J.M. Barrie and how he came to write Peter Pan. Shows run three weekends, Friday and Saturday evenings and Sunday afternoons. Tickets are $26.75.

item.title: Ice skating rink presented by Pepsi at The Wharf (THU 11/19)
item.description: Daily from 11/13 · hours vary by day | The Wharf | from $16. The Wharf in Orange Beach opens a real ice rink for the holiday season on November 13 and keeps it open through January 18. Skates are provided, beginners are welcome, and a DJ plays Friday and Saturday nights from 7:00 PM to 10:00 PM. On Tuesdays through December 8 the Wharf donates $5 to Toys for Tots for each skate purchase.

item.title: Jazz Art Writers South Festival Youth Exhibit 2026 (THU 11/19)
item.description: Nov 1 to Dec 15 · all day during branch hours, closed Sundays | Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library | No published price. More than fifty paintings by artists ages 8 to 18 who attend local public schools interpret jazz music at the Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library. The JAWS Festival put the exhibit together with the Mobile Arts Council and the Amp Up Arts Program, and it hangs from November 1 through December 15 during branch hours, which are Monday to Saturday.

item.title: Mobile in the Gilded Age exhibition at the History Museum of Mobile (THU 11/19)
item.description: Monday to Saturday 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM · Sunday 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM · through 6/6/2027 | History Museum of Mobile | from $8. The History Museum of Mobile opened Mobile in the Gilded Age on October 9, 2026, and the exhibition stays up through June 6, 2027. Gowns, inventions and everyday objects show how railroads, new technology and department stores changed life in Mobile in the late 1800s and early 1900s. The exhibition also covers the unequal opportunities and segregation of the period.

item.title: Mobile Music Legends exhibit at Moorer Branch Library (THU 11/19)
item.description: Library hours · 11/1 to 12/15 · closed Sundays | Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library | No published price. The Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library hosts the first annual Mobile Music Legends exhibit. The display celebrates artists and ensembles who carried the soul, jazz and spirit of the Gulf Coast to the world. The exhibit stays up from November 1 to December 15.

item.title: Moonlight Garden photography exhibition at Pensacola State College (THU 11/19)
item.description: Through Friday 12/11 · Mon to Thu 9 AM to 5 PM, Fri 9 AM to 3 PM | Switzer Gallery, Pensacola State College | No published price. Photographer Mark Alan Francis shows landscape prints made with the Mordançage process, which gives black and white silver gelatin prints earth tones of copper, tan and burnt sienna. The pictures look like they were taken at night under moonlight. It runs in the Switzer Gallery through Friday 12/11 and is a quiet stop on a weekday.

item.title: Moonlight Garden photography exhibition by Mark Alan Francis (THU 11/19)
item.description: Through Friday 12/11 · Weekdays | Switzer Gallery, Pensacola State College | No published price. Mark Alan Francis shows landscape photographs made with the Mordançage process, which leaves copper, tan and burnt sienna tones in black-and-white silver gelatin prints. The prints look as if they were shot at night under moonlight. The show hangs in the Switzer Gallery from November 5 through December 11.

item.title: Noises Off!: Chickasaw Civic Theatre (THU 11/19)
item.description: Nov 12-22, 2026 · eves + matinees | Chickasaw Civic Theatre | No published price. Michael Frayn's door-slamming backstage farce, one of the funniest plays ever written, plays at Chickasaw's community playhouse.

item.title: Painting with a Twist Pensacola: paint-and-sip, family paint days and date nights (weekly programme) (THU 11/19)
item.description: Classes most days: family days Saturday 10:30 AM, brunch Sunday 11 AM, evenings Wednesday to Saturday | Painting with a Twist Pensacola | $35 per family. Painting with a Twist Pensacola is an artist-led paint-and-sip studio at 4771 Bayou Blvd Suite C11 with several classes every week. October has family paint days (ages 6 and up with a parent, no alcohol), adult Paint & Sip and Date Night classes (ages 16 and up on date nights), Halloween-themed canvases and Paint Your Pet. Classes cost $35-$60 depending on the class, and alcohol is sold on site with no BYOB.

item.title: Pat Barrett: I've Got A Fire Tour (THU 11/19)
item.description: Thursday 11/19 · 7:00 PM, doors 6:15 PM | Marcus Pointe Baptist Church | from $27.62. Worship leader Pat Barrett brings his I've Got A Fire Tour, with Matt Crocker, to Marcus Pointe Baptist Church. The ticket page lists the show as all ages, and anyone over 2 needs a ticket. A group of four or more pays less per ticket than general admission.

item.title: Photos with Santa at The Wharf (THU 11/19)
item.description: Fridays to Sundays 11/13 to 12/24 · Fri 3 PM to 6 PM, Sat 10 AM to 6 PM, Sun 12 PM to 6 PM | The Wharf | No published price. The Wharf in Orange Beach sets up Photos with Santa on Fridays through Sundays from November 13 to December 24. Friday hours run 3:00 PM to 6:00 PM, Saturday 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM and Sunday 12:00 PM to 6:00 PM. The Wharf sells various price packages, and the ice rink sits next door at the same property.

item.title: Pokémon League at GameMasters Guild (THU 11/19)
item.description: Thursdays 3 PM-8 PM and Saturdays 12 PM-2 PM | GameMasters Guild | Free. Pokémon League at GameMasters Guild is free casual play for the Pokémon TCG, the Pokémon Champions video game and Pokémon GO. It runs Thursdays from 3 to 8 PM and Saturdays from 12 to 2 PM in Crestview. All ages are welcome, and the shop calls it a family-friendly space. Players get promo cards or special items while supplies last, and a free Pokémon account is needed to qualify (children under 13 register under a parent's account).

item.title: Public Ice Skating at the Pensacola Bay Center, November sessions (THU 11/19)
item.description: Nov 1 to Nov 25 · one hour sessions, see dates | Pensacola Bay Center | from $15. The Pensacola Bay Center opens its ice for one-hour public skate sessions. The November sessions run Sunday 11/1 at 6:30 PM, Saturday 11/7 and Sunday 11/8 at 1:30, 3:00 and 4:30 PM, Friday 11/13 and Saturday 11/14 at 9:30 PM, Sunday 11/15 at 1:30, 3:00 and 4:30 PM, and Wednesday 11/25 at 9:30 PM. The Bay Center states that all sessions are subject to change.

item.title: Qigong classes at Historic Blakeley (THU 11/19)
item.description: Saturday 11/7 · 9:00 AM to 10:00 AM · Saturday 11/21 · 9:00 AM to 10:00 AM | Historic Blakeley State Park | from $10. Historic Blakeley State Park offers guided Qigong, a slow, low-impact practice that combines movement, deep breathing and visualization and is described as an ancestor of Tai Chi. Classes run from 9:00 AM to 10:00 AM on Saturday 11/7 and Saturday 11/21, with an optional group hike afterward. They take place rain or shine unless there is lightning or severe weather.

item.title: The Comedy of Errors at Pensacola Christian College (THU 11/19)
item.description: Thursday 11/19 and Friday 11/20 · 7:00 PM, Saturday 11/21 · 2:00 PM | Pensacola Christian College | Free. Pensacola Christian College stages Shakespeare's The Comedy of Errors, in which two sets of identical twins land in the same city and cause a chain of mistaken identities. The Fine Arts Series lists three performances. The event is free with open seating, and doors open at 6:15 PM for the evening shows.

item.title: The Fab Four: Saenger Theatre (THU 11/19)
item.description: Thu 11/19/2026 · 7:30 PM (doors 6:30 PM) | Saenger Theatre, Pensacola | No published price. This Emmy-winning Beatles tribute plays note-for-note in period costume, an all-ages-friendly night that plays great as a date. It is downtown at the Saenger.

item.title: The View Within exhibition at Blue Morning Gallery (THU 11/19)
item.description: Sunday 10/25 to Saturday 11/28 · reception Friday 11/6 at 4:30 | Blue Morning Gallery | No published price. Blue Morning Gallery in downtown Pensacola shows The View Within, an exhibition of colorful abstract paintings by the featured artist, from October 25 through November 28. A reception on Friday November 6 at 4:30 lets visitors meet the artist, hear live music and enjoy refreshments and conversation.

item.title: Trim-a-Tree at the Foley Art Center (THU 11/19)
item.description: Friday 11/13 to Wednesday 12/23 · daily (hours to confirm) | Foley Art Center | Free. Since 1967 the Foley Art Center has opened its Trim-a-Tree holiday show on the second Friday in November, and it runs through December 23. More than 125 local artists and craftspeople sell pottery, woodcarvings, florals, jewelry, blown glass, textiles, soy candles, wooden toys and ornaments on consignment. Admission is free.

item.title: University of Mobile Christmas Spectacular at Cottage Hill (THU 11/19)
item.description: Thursday 11/19 to Sunday 11/22 · Thu and Fri 7:00 PM, Sat 2:00 PM, Sun 4:00 PM | Cottage Hill Baptist Church | No published price. The University of Mobile's Christmas Spectacular is an annual holiday show by students of the Alabama School of the Arts, held again at Cottage Hill Baptist Church. Carols and newer holiday songs come from choirs, a full orchestra, a jazz band, a Celtic string ensemble and several vocal groups. Tickets are sold only through the university's Christmas ticket page.

item.title: Wanda Sullivan: Bloem Exhibition (THU 11/19)
item.description: Now through December 11 | Anna Lamar Switzer Center for Visual Arts | No published price. A gallery exhibition by artist Wanda Sullivan runs at Pensacola State College's visual arts center through mid-December. The center's own site does not publish an admission price.

item.title: Cornhole Open Play (THU 11/19)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | from $5. Members toss bags at the boards during open-play cornhole at the Niceville Senior Center. It runs casually throughout the center's regular weekday hours. City of Niceville residents play free, and everyone else pays a $5 day rate.

item.title: Exercise Room (THU 11/19)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | from $5. The Niceville Senior Center's exercise room stays open for members to work through strength, cardio, and flexibility routines on their own schedule. Equipment includes two recumbent bikes, a treadmill, free weights, a stability ball, mats, and stretch bands. City of Niceville residents get free access, and everyone else pays a $5 day rate.

item.title: Putting Green Open Play (THU 11/19)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | from $5. Members check out putters and balls at the front desk to practice on the Niceville Senior Center's putting green. It is casual, and you can work on your short game alone or play a round with friends. City of Niceville residents get free access, and everyone else pays a $5 day rate.

item.title: Table Tennis Open Play (THU 11/19)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | No published price. Niceville Senior Center's table tennis room is open for casual, drop-in play with no experience required. The city describes it as an active, social way to spend the morning rather than a competitive league. It shares the Tuesday 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM window with several other open-play programs at the center, and members age 55 and up are the intended audience.

item.title: Yoga Breeze (THU 11/19)
item.description: Thursdays · 8:30 AM to 9:30 AM | Niceville Senior Center | from $3. Yoga Breeze is a gentle Hatha yoga class at the Niceville Senior Center, built around flexibility, balance, posture and joint friendly movement. The city says it suits all skill levels, not just experienced practitioners. It asks a $3 donation.

item.title: Friends of the Library book sale at Fairhope Public Library (THU 11/19)
item.description: Thursday 11/19 · 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM | Fairhope Public Library, Giddens Conference Center | No published price. The Friends of the Fairhope Library hold a book sale in the library lobby and the Giddens Conference Center. The sale offers fiction, nonfiction, children's books, DVDs, artwork and puzzles. All proceeds benefit the library.

item.title: Guided Pier Walk at Gulf State Park (THU 11/19)
item.description: Friday 11/13 · 9:00 AM · Friday 11/20 · 9:00 AM | Gulf State Park Pier | Free. A Gulf State Park naturalist leads a guided tour of the Gulf State Park Pier on two Friday mornings in November. The walk covers the pier's history, local conservation work, and the fish and birds that live around it. The park lists the walk as free and great for all ages, but pier parking costs $15 for the day.

item.title: Namaste by the Bay free community yoga at Waterfront Park (THU 11/19)
item.description: Saturday 9:00 AM | Orange Beach Waterfront Park | Free. Orange Beach Parks and Recreation runs free community yoga by the water on Saturday mornings from 9:00 AM to 10:00 AM, with a different instructor each week. All ages and levels are welcome. The November sessions fall on 11/7, 11/14, 11/21 and 11/28.

item.title: Baby Bookworms Lapsit Story Time @ the Library (THU 11/19)
item.description: Thursdays · 9:30 AM to 10:00 AM | Niceville Public Library: Youth Services Program Room | No published price. Niceville Public Library's Youth Services Program Room offers a lapsit story time built around music, stories and rhymes for infants and pre-walkers with their caregivers. The library holds this session Thursday mornings at 9:30 AM.

item.title: Chair Yoga (THU 11/19)
item.description: 9:45 AM to 10:45 AM | Niceville Senior Center | from $3. This Chair Yoga class at the Niceville Senior Center mixes seated poses with supported standing work. It aims at posture, flexibility, core strength, joint mobility, balance, stability and stress reduction. It asks a $3 donation and repeats every Tuesday and Thursday morning, for members age 55 and up.

item.title: Ages 3 to 5 Storytime Class at Crestview Library (THU 11/19)
item.description: Wednesdays or Thursdays · 10:00 AM | Crestview Library: Story Room | No published price. Crestview Library holds a weekly storytime class for preschoolers, with families choosing either the Wednesday or the Thursday session at 10:00 AM. Each class has stories, music, movement and a craft around a theme, such as Bugs on November 4 or 5, Kindness on November 12 and Octopus on November 18 or 19. Younger siblings and older children are welcome.

item.title: Aminah Robinson: Journeys Home at the Mobile Museum of Art (THU 11/19)
item.description: Tuesday to Saturday · 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM · through 1/9 | Mobile Museum of Art | from $8. Aminah Robinson: Journeys Home is a special exhibition at the Mobile Museum of Art that draws on the artist's historical research, folklore and personal narrative. The museum describes it as a visual memoir of her life and a tableau of the African American experience. It stays open through January 9, 2027.

item.title: Coco & Crawlers (THU 11/19)
item.description: Third Thursday of the month · 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM | Ben May Main Library, Youth Programming Room | No published price. This caregiver meetup in the Youth Programming Room at Ben May Main Library pairs children's play with a warm drink. It gives caregivers time to connect with each other. It runs Thursday morning from 10 AM to 11 AM, repeating on the third Thursday of the month, with more dates on October 15, November 19 and December 17. Registration is requested but not required.

item.title: Gateway: From Graffiti to Gallery at the Mobile Museum of Art (THU 11/19)
item.description: Tuesday to Saturday · 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM, through 9/1/2027 | Mobile Museum of Art | from $8. The Mobile Museum of Art traces how artists who started with graffiti in New York's subways moved into galleries, with work by Basquiat, Haring, Scharf, KAWS and Banksy from the Masterworks Foundation collection. The show runs a full year, Tuesday through Saturday. Mobile County residents get in free on Thursdays.

item.title: Handle with Care at the Mobile Museum of Art (THU 11/19)
item.description: Tuesday to Saturday · 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM · through 3/27 | Mobile Museum of Art | from $8. Handle with Care is an interactive special exhibition at the Mobile Museum of Art. Artists Calder Kamin of Austin and Jacob Reptile of New Orleans turn trash into soft, complex sculptures that visitors move through as an environment. It stays open through March 27, 2027.

item.title: Make It Last: Gallery Exhibition at UWF (THU 11/19)
item.description: Weekdays through 11/20 · 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM | UWF Center for Fine and Performing Arts, Building 82, The Art Gallery | Free. Make It Last is an exhibition in The Art Gallery at the UWF Center for Fine and Performing Arts, curated by a UWF graduate. Six artists share the space, which includes a conversation pit in the gallery alcove and a poetry wall that visitors fill with their own work. Admission is free.
